events.doc: Edges lit by attention. At rest the web is a faint ink; what the reader or the agent is attending to lights its links, and everything else nearly vanishes while something is hovered or picked. The numbers are the AI Coding Dictionary's.

events.doc: Where playback starts when Play is pressed: after the step last shown, or at the current checkpoint's first play when nothing has been shown there; from the start of the thread once it has played to the end.

events.name: holdSeconds
